annotations.title: Approve, reject or archive many held items at once

description:
[DESTRUCTIVE] Decides 1–100 held-content items from approvals_list (`ids`) in one call, each exactly as approvals_decide would. `action` "approve" marks content approved (NOT posted) or resumes a parked workflow run (which may publish — GOES LIVE); "reject" sends content back to draft and cancels a parked run (`note` = reason, required when the org asks for one); "archive" closes the approval and archives the content (restorable). Ad budget requests ("ad_budget") and rotation drafts are NEVER bulk-approved: they come back `skipped`; approve those one at a time with approvals_decide. Full description and schema: describe_tool {"name":"approvals_bulk_decide"}.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/approvals/bulk.)

action.description: Format: string; e.g. "reject". Operation to perform.

dryRun.description: Format: boolean; e.g. false. Preview the result without applying changes.

ids.description: Format: array; e.g. ["Example"]. Record identifiers returned by the corresponding list tool.

note.description: Format: string; e.g. "Example". On reject: the reason. Optional unless the org requires one. On approve: recorded with the decision.

when.description: Format: JSON; e.g. "tray". Approve only. "tray" (the default): approved, not booked. { spread }: approved and booked in `ids` order. Several shapes; describe_tool shows them.

name: approvals_bulk_decide
title: Approve, reject or archive many held items at once
